question: Which of the following processes is NOT a point mutation in the DNA sequence ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Translocation" -> "involves the movement of a chromosome segment to a different location" -> "does not change the nucleotide sequence at a single point" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Insertion" -> "adds one or more nucleotides into the DNA sequence" -> "results in a change in the sequence" -> "is a point mutation" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Deletion" -> "removes one or more nucleotides from the DNA sequence" -> "results in a change in the sequence" -> "is a point mutation" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Substitution" -> "replaces one nucleotide with another" -> "results in a change in the sequence" -> "is a point mutation" -> 90%
analysis: Translocation involves the movement of a segment of DNA from one location to another, which is not classified as a point mutation. Point mutations include insertion, deletion, and substitution, which all affect a single nucleotide or a small number of nucleotides.
